instruction: How many likes did all Venmo transactions, I sent this month, have in total?
notes: Read-only question task: the goal only requires the aggregated like total to be found and the task completed; no database changes are modeled. Knowledge gating: show_profile -> profile-known (username), show_account_passwords -> passwords-known, phone.get_current_date_and_time -> date-known (used to derive the month-start threshold 2023-05-01, stored as a static month-start fact), venmo.login -> has-token. venmo-show-transactions carries the optional filters actually used (min_created_at, min_like_count=1, direction=sent) and asserts found-total-likes for the single count object, which is passed as the answer to supervisor-complete-task (the agent must page through all results and sum like_count). venmo and phone are domain constants, not problem objects.
